events.note: Authored for redact-secret#1228 (Group C, Batch 2 follow-up) from the evidence repository's own handoffs C1, C2 and C3 and the cited draft contracts only; carrier existence is provider-documented, the context policy is project policy. Not an independent review.

Decided 2026-10-06 by the sole maintainer (Milo Kang, milocosmopolitan, repository owner), authored as maintainer-only on the owner's explicit instruction (owner instruction on 2026-10-06: complete redact-secret#1228, #1229 and #1230 before the next release; baselines and Cases for these groups to be authored maintainer-only as in Batch 2). Question: a value in the client_secret parameter of an OAuth Server-to-Server token request, in a form body or a query string, is a credential whatever its shape? Options: require the p8e- prefix and a 32-character body (two rule artifacts, no Adobe statement); flag any value in the documented parameter; or leave the case a draft. Decision: flag any value in the client_secret parameter, form body or query; no prefix, width or alphabet is claimed and no subtype is inferred. Reason: Adobe documents only that the carrier exists and that no format is stated, so the expectation rests on project policy, not on a provider rule; the prefix is a tool lead of unattributed type and independence of the two rules is unshown. Finalized by the sole maintainer alone under the solo-maintainer period (ADR 0020): not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). Recorded by an AI agent on the owner's instruction.
events.dissent: No dissent was raised in this decision. Strongest counter-argument recorded: the provider pages document the carrier but state no value format, so a position-only rule can flag non-secrets or miss a differently shaped secret; leaving the case a draft would claim nothing.
events.reversingEvidence: A provider statement of the value format or of the carrier's confidentiality that contradicts this outcome, or a second maintainer's retro-review that disputes it.
